name: @ever-works/job-runtime-node-plugin
description: Fleet node IJobRuntimeProvider plugin for Ever Works — the queue is the owner's enrolled machines: enqueue writes a lease-able job row, nodes poll for work over the existing outbound-only fleet channel, results come back the same way (Desktop PRD M4).

plugin.name: Fleet Node Job Runtime
plugin.description: Executes platform work on the machines the owner enrolled in Fleet. Enqueue writes a lease-able fleet job row; enrolled nodes claim it with an atomic CAS lease, keep the claim alive with job heartbeats, and report results — all over the existing outbound-only node channel, so no inbound port is opened on a user's machine. A node that dies mid-job has its lease reclaimed and the work re-offered to the fleet.
